    path = r["data"]["text"].strip()
    chain = []
    guard = 0
    while True:
        guard += 1
        if guard > 100:
            return {"error": "too long", "chain": chain}
        node = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "/workspace/" + path})
        txt = node["data"]["text"]
        fields = {}
        for line in txt.split("\n"):
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            k, v = line.split("=", 1)
            fields[k.strip()] = v.strip()
        val = int(fields["value"])
        chain.append((path, val, fields.get("left"), fields.get("right")))
        nxt = "left" if val % 2 == 0 else "right"
        np = fields.get(nxt, "")
        if np == "END" or "END" in np.upper():
            break
        path = np
    return {"chain": chain}
